about: What changed in each version, for families: short, only what affects play. The game shows the newest entry only (js/game.js).

notes: Your Teacher asks up to 7 questions in longer sūrahs, 15 seconds each, and rests once every sūrah is roaring for the day
Word Steps: Listen lights up each word as it's recited
Lots more to win: pants, watches (some glow!), stickers and more. Memorize every sūrah to unlock every design
The Summit crown now comes once every sūrah is memorized, and journal pictures from steps you've finished
My Achievements shows how many things are left to win; speeds now 0.5× to 2×, with 1.25×
The sūrahs list shows which sūrahs are green or golden
Stars shows just the stars, with room for every sūrah's meaning

Campfires burn down step by step: roaring, strong, steady, low, embers, out
Extra hearts come later, for the long sūrahs near the top
Fixed: a gift card that couldn't be closed; the frog now lands right on the next set of stones
Journal pictures are collected in Look & Repeat (not during chain time or the other games)

Surprises now keep coming all the way to the last star

Winning back what fell is its own gift (no extra gift on top)
